Salary: Location-dependent (UK: Â£30,000âÂ£35,000 GBP / Canada: CAD $48,000â$57,000) + share options

Location: UK or Canada (Atlantic Time Zone only)

Meet The Guru

Resource Guru is a blissfully simple scheduling tool that helps busy teams stay on track.

We boost efficiency, improve resource utilisation, and increase project profitability - while promoting a healthy work/life balance.

Weâre proud to be one of the leaders in our category, trusted by customers in over 100 countries - including top creative agencies like Publicis, TBWA, Grey, BBH, and M&C Saatchi, as well as household names like NASA, Accenture, CNN, Kraft Heinz, and the NHS. They rely on Resource Guru to manage one of their most valuable assets - their peopleâs time.

Weâre a small, fully remote team based across the UK and Europe. We collaborate mainly via Slack, with occasional meetups to connect, plan, and celebrate. See if this is the right place for you.

â­ï¸ The role

Weâre looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join our team.

As more teams use Resource Guru and as we continue to support larger, more complex customers we want to make sure every customer receives fast, clear, thoughtful and genuinely helpful support.

This role is primarily about helping customers by email, understanding their questions, troubleshooting issues, and making sure they get the best possible experience from Resource Guru.

Youâll work closely with Dana, our Senior Customer Support Specialist, and collaborate with our product and engineering teams when customer questions, bugs or feature requests need to be investigated further. We see Customer Support as a core part of building a great product, so youâll work closely with the rest of the team to help improve Resource Guru, not just answer support tickets.

This is a great role for someone with some experience in SaaS or online customer support who wants to keep developing their technical, communication and customer-facing skills in a friendly, remote-first team.

What Youâll Be Doing

Learning Resource Guru inside out

  • In your first few months, you'll get to know Resource Guru inside out - how customers use the product, what common questions come up, and how to guide people towards the right answer.

Responding to customer questions

  • Help customers with day-to-day support questions, including product usage, account setup, billing enquiries, troubleshooting and general "how do Iâ¦?" queries.
  • Most support is handled by email, though you may occasionally join a phone or video call when that would help resolve something more quickly.

Troubleshooting problems

  • Investigate customer issues carefully and methodically - asking the right follow-up questions, checking account settings, trying to reproduce a problem, looking for browser-related issues, or escalating a bug to engineering with clear notes.

Working with the wider team

  • Work closely with Dana and the wider Resource Guru team to understand customer questions, resolve issues, and make sure useful feedback is shared with Product and Engineering.
  • Help create clear internal reports when customers report bugs or technical issues, and tag/categorise feature feedback so the team understands what customers need.

Improving our help content

About Oula

The Role

At Oula, our product doesn't sit alongside our EHR â it integrates directly into it. Every product and engineering decision has downstream consequences for how our EHRs are configured, and every EHR configuration decision shapes what's possible on the product side. Someone has to hold both at once.

We're looking for a technically-minded Product Manager to own and evolve our core technology stack â including our EHR, patient portal, and care management platform. This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, and health system integration, serving as the internal and external subject matter expert on our EMR and the primary lead for health system EHR integrations.

You'll manage the day-to-day health of our tech stack, partnering closely with both internal teams and external health system stakeholders to ensure our systems run smoothly and our integrations deliver. You can sit with a midwife and understand why a clinical template matters, then turn around and write a bug ticket that engineering can actually action, then build the SOP so the next market launch doesn't require you to be in the room. When things are ambiguous (and they often are), you'll lean in rather than wait for clarity.

What You'll Own

EHR Configuration & Clinical Systems

  • Own Athena and Epic configuration end to end: clinical templates, order sets, lab configurations, payer connectivity, and access management for clinical and ops staff

Product Operations & Launch

  • Build structured launch toolkits and training materials so clinic teams are prepared for new feature rollouts on day one
  • Coordinate end-to-end launches across Product, Engineering, and Operations

Standards & Knowledge Management

  • Develop onboarding materials for clinic managers and clinical staff on EHR workflows and tooling

Data & Reporting

What You Bring

  • 3+ years with product operations, technical program management, or PM-adjacent work â ideally at a growth-stage digital health or services company

  • Analytical enough to build a dashboard and identify a pattern, even if you're not a SQL expert

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you've audited our current Athena configuration, identified gaps, and have a remediation plan. You understand the bug triage process well enough to have improved it. You've met your counterparts at every health system partner and know what's coming for the next Epic integration.

At six months, new market launches have a repeatable systems and product checklist. Clinic teams know what to expect before a feature goes live. Bug resolution time is measurably faster and the field is no longer sending issues into a black hole.

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Moonpay Enterprise
description:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.


The role

We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most.

Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform

Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) verification flows, risk scoring, sanctions and AML screening, case management, and integrations with identity and compliance vendors. The challenge is making rigorous compliance feel invisible: fast, automated, and globally scalable, without ever compromising on regulatory obligations.

Track 2: New Product Lines, starting with Custody

Join us at the ground floor of new enterprise products, beginning with Custody. You’ll design the backend for secure digital asset storage and management for institutional clients: key management workflows, policy engines, transaction authorization, ledger integrity, and audit trails. This track suits engineers who love ambiguity, greenfield architecture, and building products from zero to one with enterprise-grade security requirements.

Track 3: Blockchain, Stablecoin Issuance & On-Chain Infrastructure

Work directly with blockchain protocols to power our stablecoin issuance business and on-chain products. You’ll build and operate services for minting, burning, and managing fully reserved stablecoins across chains, develop smart contract integrations on EVM chains and Solana, and design the indexing, monitoring, and reconciliation systems that keep on-chain and off-chain state in sync. Prior Solana (Rust) or Solidity development experience is a strong plus here.

Across all tracks, experience with fiat rails, banking integrations, or payments systems is very welcome. Much of our hardest work happens where traditional finance and crypto overlap.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and operate backend services written in Rust that process high volumes of financial transactions with strong guarantees around correctness, idempotency, and auditability
  • Own features end to end, from shaping the product spec through technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. You won’t just receive work from product: as a domain expert, you’ll help define what we build and propose the work you consider most useful
  • Integrate with external partners such as banks, payment processors, blockchains, and identity and compliance vendors, and build the abstractions that make those integrations reliable
  • Improve engineering quality across observability, incident response, security practices, and API design
  • Collaborate closely with product, compliance, and other engineering teams across MoonPay’s global network
  • (Staff level) Set technical direction for your area, mentor other engineers, and drive architectural decisions that span multiple teams

About you

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience (8+ for Staff), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale
  • Strong backend experience with a statically compiled language (e.g. Rust, Go, C#, C++) is a must. Deep fundamentals matter more to us than your specific language history
  • Prior professional Rust experience is not required, but interest in Rust and motivation to become an expert in it are very welcome, since our services are written in Rust
  • Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, and asynchronous processing
  • Comfort working in domains where precision matters, such as financial systems, double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, or similarly correctness-critical software
  • A pragmatic, autonomous, ownership-driven mindset. You care about outcomes, communicate clearly, and thrive on high throughput: on this team, features ship in hours to days and products in days to weeks
  • Strong critical thinking, including in how you use AI tools. You know how to drive AI-assisted development productively while staying firmly in control of correctness, security, and design quality
  • Interest in crypto, stablecoins, and the future of payments. Prior crypto experience is a plus rather than a requirement, except for Track 3, where hands-on blockchain development experience is expected

Bonus points

  • Professional or hobby experience writing Rust (open-source contributions count!)
  • Experience in fiat payments, banking integrations, card networks, or PSPs
  • Familiarity with KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, or regulated financial products (Track 1)
  • Background in custody, key management (MPC/HSM), or institutional-grade security (Track 2)
  • Smart contract development in Solidity (EVM) or Rust (Solana), and experience with on-chain indexing or node infrastructure (Track 3)
  • Experience working in regulated, multi-jurisdiction environments

How we work

MoonPay Enterprise operates like a startup inside a scale-up: small, senior, high-throughput teams with real ownership, direct access to customers and decision-makers, and the backing of MoonPay’s global licenses, banking relationships, and distribution network. We move fast and expect engineers to act as product owners for their domain, not just implementers. This role is open fully remote, or hybrid from our Berlin, Germany hub if you prefer time with the team in person.

title: Head of Sales (m/w/d) Erfahrung mit SaaS
description:
Für meinen langjähringen Kunden bin ich auf der Suche nach einem Head of Sales (m/w/d)

Wir suchen einen Head of Sales (m/w/d), der nicht nur selbst erfolgreich verkaufen kann, sondern vor allem andere Vertriebler erfolgreich macht.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die vertriebliche Performance und Weiterentwicklung unseres gesamten Key Account Teams. Du führst als Player-Coach, entwickelst unsere KAMs individuell weiter und sorgst dafür, dass aus guten Vertriebsmitarbeitern zunehmend selbstständige und strategisch agierende Umsatzträger werden.

Dabei geht es nicht darum, die schwierigsten Deals selbst zu übernehmen. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich daran, dass dein Team diese Deals zunehmend selbst erfolgreich abschließt.

Aufgaben

Führung & Coaching

  • Du kennst die Stärken und Entwicklungsfelder deiner KAMs und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter.
  • Du definierst gemeinsam mit deinen Teammitgliedern konkrete Entwicklungsziele und Maßnahmen.
  • Du coachst direkt an realen Accounts, Opportunities und Kundensituationen.
  • Du entwickelst deine KAMs insbesondere in den Bereichen Neukundenakquisition, strategisches Account Management, Value Selling, Entscheider-Management, Verhandlung und Closing.
  • Du bereitest wichtige Kundentermine und Verhandlungen gemeinsam mit deinen KAMs vor und reflektierst diese anschließend.
  • Du gibst Verantwortung nicht an dich, sondern an dein Team zurück und entwickelst dadurch Selbstständigkeit und Ownership.

Vertriebssteuerung & Performance

  • Du übersetzt unsere Unternehmens- und Sales-Ziele in klare Ziele und Erwartungen für das Team.
  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit den KAMs Umsatz, Pipeline, Account-Entwicklung und Neukundenakquisition.
  • Du stellst eine belastbare Pipeline und einen realistischen Forecast sicher.
  • Du erkennst frühzeitig Risiken, Pipeline-Lücken und Performance-Abweichungen und leitest gemeinsam mit dem Team konkrete Maßnahmen ein.
  • Du führst regelmäßige Account- und Opportunity Reviews durch und stellst sicher, dass die richtigen Strategien und nächsten Schritte verfolgt werden.

Sales Excellence

  • Du etablierst klare und einheitliche Vertriebsstandards.
  • Du entwickelst Best Practices und sorgst dafür, dass diese im gesamten Team angewendet werden.
  • Du stärkst eine konsequente Akquisitions-, Wachstums- und Abschlussorientierung.
  • Du entwickelst das Team von reaktiver Kundenbetreuung hin zu aktiver und strategischer Geschäftsentwicklung.
  • Du stärkst die Ownership für Pipeline, Umsatz und nachhaltiges Subskriptionswachstum.

Player-Coach – ca. 20 % eigene Sales-Aktivität

Du bleibst selbst nah am Markt und an unseren Kunden. Rund 20 % deiner Zeit investierst du in eigene operative Vertriebsaktivitäten.

Dabei übernimmst du bewusst eine begrenzte Anzahl eigener Accounts und Opportunities, betreibst selbst Neukundenakquisition und arbeitest bei ausgewählten strategischen oder komplexen Opportunities gemeinsam mit deinen KAMs.

Deine eigene Vertriebsarbeit hat vor allem einen Zweck: Du machst Best Practices vor, bleibst nah am Markt und bringst deine Erfahrung direkt in das Coaching deines Teams ein.

Qualifikation

Du bist ein erfahrener Sales-Profi und hast selbst erfolgreich komplexe Vertriebsprozesse gesteuert.

Du bringst insbesondere Erfahrung mit in:

  • erfolgreicher Neukundenakquisition
  • strategischer Account-Entwicklung
  • komplexen Sales-Prozessen
  • Value Selling
  • Entscheider-Management
  • Verhandlung und Closing
  • Pipeline- und Forecast-Management
  • Partner- und Ecosystem-Selling
  • unternehmerischem und kaufmännischem Denken

Idealerweise hast du bereits Führungserfahrung im Vertrieb gesammelt oder möchtest den nächsten Schritt vom Senior KAM zum Head of Sales gehen.

Wichtig ist uns vor allem: Du kannst nicht nur selbst verkaufen – du kannst Vertriebskompetenz auf andere übertragen.

Was dich in dieser Rolle auszeichnet:

Du bist Coach und Führungskraft, ohne deinen Sales-Hintergrund zu verlieren.

Du gibst Orientierung, stellst klare Erwartungen und forderst Ergebnisse ein. Gleichzeitig verstehst du, dass nachhaltiger Vertriebserfolg entsteht, wenn Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.

Dein Führungsprinzip:

Vormachen → gemeinsam machen → Verantwortung übergeben.

title: Creative Strategist (m/w/d) - Vollzeit, vor Ort in Lingen
description:
Du schaust auf einen Ad Account und siehst nach zwei Minuten, wo es hakt? Welcher Angle als Nächstes dran ist, welche Hook fehlt, warum der Winner gerade abbaut?

Dann lies weiter.

Wer wir sind

Commerce Ventures ist die führende Performance-Marketing-Agentur, im Food, Health und Beverage Bereich. Wir betreuen ausschließlich Brands, hinter denen wir stehen, von Gründern und Gründerinnen, die ambitioniert sind und wirklich coole Produkte entwickelt haben.

Monatlich laufen sechsstellige Meta-Budgets über unsere Accounts, und wir haben mehr als eine Brand von null auf achtstellig begleitet.

Der Hebel dahinter ist immer das Creative. Dafür haben wir ein Modell gebaut, das funktioniert: klare Prozesse, klare Zahlen, klare Verantwortung, und Leute, die liefern. Kein Agentur-Bullshit, keine 40-seitigen Decks.

Was du machst

Du übernimmst deine eigenen Brands, in kompletter Eigenverantwortung, drei bis vier Brands maximal, damit du dich voll und ganz auf die Ergebnisse unserer Kunden konzentrieren kannst.

Du übernimmst die komplette Creative Strategy, Media Buying, Kunden-Calls, Planung. Du briefst unsere Post-Production, du entscheidest, was live geht, du weißt jeden Morgen, was die Zahlen sagen und was heute zu tun ist.

Damit wir uns nicht falsch verstehen: Wir suchen keinen Strategen, der Konzepte präsentiert und andere machen lässt. Du setzt die Strategie und lieferst selbst: Angles, Hooks, Skripte, Briefings, Statics. Wer lieber Slides baut und mehr redet als macht, ist bei uns falsch.

Wie wir arbeiten

Wir sind ein kleines Team, remote aufgestellt, und trotzdem haben wir gerade unser Büro in Lingen vergrößert. Warum? Weil die Lernkurve neben Gründer und Team im Office steiler ist als in jedem Google-Meet. Wer die Rolle vor Ort macht, lernt es von denen, die es jeden Tag machen! Und bekommt JUUZ und Prepmymeal Meals im Kühlschrank obendrauf.

Heißt aber nicht, dass remote nicht geht. Wenn du gut bist und selbstständig arbeitest können wir reden. Lingen ist unser Wunsch, aber nicht die Bedingung.

Was bei uns gilt: Wir arbeiten hart, weil gemeinsam Ziele erreichen, Spaß macht!

Wir sagen uns direkt, was Sache ist. Und wir feiern, wenn ein Kunde den Umsatz verdoppelt.

Kurz, unser Motto: doing cool shit with cool people!

Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Creative- und Funnel-Strategie für deine Accounts: von der Analyse über den Testplan bis zum fertigen Creative.
  • Du analysierst die Ad Accounts, findest die Lücken (fehlende Angles, , schwache Hooks, schwache Landingpages) und leitest daraus konkrete Testpläne ab.
  • Du entscheidest, was als Nächstes launcht, und priorisierst nach Wirkunk und nicht nach Bauchgefühl.
  • Du schreibst Hooks, Skripte und Ad Copy selbst und baust Statics und Animations, wenn der Account sie braucht.
  • Du briefst UGC-Creator, Editoren und unsere Post-Production und challengst sie so lange, bis die Creatives performen.
  • Du führst deine Kunden-Calls selbst, präsentierst Zahlen und hast den vollen Überblick über deine Accounts (maximal drei).
  • Du iterierst Winner weiter und leitest aus den Performance-Daten die nächste Version ab.
  • Du arbeitest täglich mit Claude und Co., baust dir eigene Prompts und Workflows und nutzt AI, um schneller und besser zu liefern als der Markt.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung als Creative Strategist, Media Buyer, Direct-Response-Marketer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise im D2C- bzw. E-Commerce-Bereich.
  • Du denkst in Funnels, Awareness Stages (Schwartz), Angles und Hypothesen, nicht in Branding-Kampagnen.
  • Du hast Creatives, Hooks, Skripte oder Funnels nicht nur konzipiert, sondern selbst gebaut, und sie haben performt.
  • Du arbeitest datengetrieben und schaust auf die Zahlen: ROAS, CAC, CTR, Hook-Rate, Hold-Rate.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit KI-Tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Magnific und Co.) oder brennst darauf, sie in deinen Workflow zu bauen.
  • Du ziehst Themen eigenständig durch, lieferst sauber und gibst Gas, auch wenn keiner zuschaut.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du redest nicht über Ideen, du setzt sie um.
  • Du willst vor Ort arbeiten, in Lingen (Ems) oder Umgebung.
  • Lebenslauf, Studium oder Titel auf dem Papier sind uns egal. Deine Erfahrung und Expertise zählt, sowie dein Character.

Benefits

  • Eine Lernkurve, die es so kaum irgendwo gibt: 6-stellige Meta-Budgets, direkter Draht zum Gründer, Feedback in Tagen statt in Quartalen.
  • Ausschließlich Brands, hinter denen wir stehen: Food, Health und Supplements. Keine Kunden, für die du dich rechtfertigen musst.
  • Geiles Office in Lingen, ein Ort, an dem man wirklich gerne arbeitet.
  • Neueste Hardware (Apple-Universum) und der komplette AI-Stack, den du brauchst.
  • JUUZ & Prepmymeal-Vorrat im Kühlschrank
  • Attraktives Fixum plus Performance-Bonus
  • Ergebnisse vor Anwesenheit: flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege, keine Konzern-Bürokratie.
  • Neue Arbeitskultur, positive Vibes, Hands-on statt Meeting-Marathon.
  • Die Chance, den Creative-Bereich einer wachsenden Agentur mitzugestalten und später ein eigenes Team zu führen.

Bis hierhin durchgelesen? Dann sind wir vielleicht dein Match.

Schick uns ein kurzes, ungezwungenes Anschreiben per du: Was hast du bisher gebaut, welche Creatives, Hooks oder Funnels von dir haben am besten performt, ab wann könntest du starten? Portfolio, Ad-Beispiele, Loom: immer her damit.

Bitte kein 5-Seiten-Roman mit "teamfähig und belastbar", sondern kurz und knapp zeigen, wer du bist und was du drauf hast.

Wenn du magst, nimm ein kurzes Video auf und beantworte zwei Fragen: Wer bist du? Und warum sollte man dich unbedingt im Team haben?

Danach lernen wir uns 15 Minuten kennen und schauen, ob es passt.

Ich freue mich besonders auf Leute aus Lingen und Umgebung.

Liebe Grüße,

Marek

title: Senior Finance Manager Germany (m/w/d)
description:
Finance bekommt Ihre Handschrift.

Was würden Sie aufbauen, wenn Sie Finance für ein wachsendes Deutschlandgeschäft gestalten könnten?

Als businessnaher Senior Finance Manager entwickeln Sie die Finance-Funktion der deutschen Niederlassung eines internationalen Generikaherstellers. Sie sind die zentrale Finance-Person vor Ort und gestalten mit dem Country Manager die nächsten Schritte des Geschäfts. Der Konzern verfügt über eigene Wirkstoff- und Arzneimittelherstellung.

Vielleicht liegt Ihr Schwerpunkt heute in Commercial Finance, Controlling oder FP&A. Vielleicht verbinden Sie Finance und Markt bereits im Pricing, Tender Management, Pharmagroßhandel oder Arzneimittelimport. Entscheidend sind Ihr fundiertes Finance-Profil und praktische Erfahrung mit der Finanzmechanik des deutschen Generikageschäfts. Auch eine frühere Station kann dafür die Grundlage sein.

ANDRIS Consulting begleitet die Besetzung als Personalberatung im Auftrag des Unternehmens. Die Anstellung erfolgt beim Auftraggeber.

Aufgaben

  • Geschäftsideen weiterentwickeln: Sie bewerten neue Produkte und Marketinginitiativen, rechnen Szenarien durch und erarbeiten mit dem Country Manager Empfehlungen für Investitionen.
  • Gross-to-net verantworten: Sie gestalten die Prozesse rund um Krankenkassenrabatte, stimmen Forderungen ab und sorgen für nachvollziehbare Rückstellungen, Preisprüfungen und Freigaben.
  • Tender wirtschaftlich bewerten: Gemeinsam mit dem Head of Tender Management prüfen Sie Kalkulationen und gestalten tragfähige Angebote. Sie machen die Auswirkungen von Preisannahmen und Kosten auf die Marge sichtbar.
  • Finance mit dem Geschäft entwickeln: Sie verbessern Reporting und Abläufe, erkennen Risiken früh und begleiten die Umsetzung. Dabei arbeiten Sie auch mit Supply Chain und Logistik zusammen.
  • Planung und Liquidität steuern: Sie gestalten Forecasts mit Vertrieb und Supply Chain. Treasury und die laufende Liquiditätsübersicht für Deutschland verantworten Sie gemeinsam mit dem europäischen Finance-Team.
  • Das finanzielle Fundament sichern: Mit internen und externen Fachleuten stellen Sie Steuer- und Statistikmeldungen sicher, einschließlich Umsatz- und Körperschaftsteuer, und begleiten die Abschlussprüfung.

Qualifikation

  • Fundiertes Finance-Profil: Mindestens zehn Jahre Finance-Erfahrung, gerne auch in geschäftsnahen Aufgaben innerhalb von Pricing, Tender Management oder angrenzenden Bereichen.
  • Praktische Deutschland-Generika-Erfahrung: Sie kennen Gross-to-net, Krankenkassenrabatte und Rückstellungen aus eigener Arbeit und können Tender wirtschaftlich bewerten. Diese Erfahrung kann auch aus einer früheren Position oder einer passenden Aufgabe im Pharmagroßhandel beziehungsweise Arzneimittelimport stammen.
  • Freude am Business: Sie denken Geschäftsmöglichkeiten durch, vertreten Ihre Empfehlungen und möchten gemeinsam etwas aufbauen. Strategischer Blick und eigene Umsetzung gehören für Sie zusammen.
  • Sicheres Handwerk: Sehr gutes Excel und praktische Erfahrung mit SAP. Sie erklären wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge verständlich.
  • Deutsch und Englisch: Deutsch mindestens auf B2-Niveau, C1 bevorzugt, sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.
  • Hilfreiche Ergänzungen: Weiterführende Accounting- oder betriebswirtschaftliche Qualifikationen sowie Erfahrung mit dem Aufbau von Prozessen in einem wachsenden Unternehmen sind willkommen.

Benefits

  • Gestaltung in Deutschland: Sie übernehmen lokale Finance-Verantwortung und entwickeln die finanzielle Steuerung auf Basis vorhandener Prozesse weiter.
  • Nähe zu Geschäftsentscheidungen: Sie arbeiten eng mit dem Country Manager und dem Tender Management. Vor Ort berichten Sie an den Country Manager, fachlich an die europäische Finance-Leitung.
  • Zusammenarbeit in Frankfurt am Main: Hier entstehen Strategie und gemeinsame Entscheidungen. Gesucht ist jemand, der diesen persönlichen Austausch schätzt und vor Ort etwas entwickeln möchte.
  • Hybrid mit individueller Abstimmung: Ergänzende Remote-Anteile schaffen Spielraum für Beruf und Familie. Die Ausgestaltung stimmen Sie anhand der Aufgabe und Ihrer persönlichen Situation gemeinsam ab. Eine reine Remote-Tätigkeit ist nicht vorgesehen.

Das Vergütungspaket besprechen wir im persönlichen Austausch.

Was reizt Sie daran, Finance in Deutschland zu entwickeln?

Nutzen Sie die Bewerbungsfunktion und schreiben Sie uns ein paar Sätze dazu. Ein Motivationsschreiben brauchen Sie für den Einstieg nicht. Wir melden uns kurzfristig und behandeln Ihr Interesse vertraulich.

Christoph Andris
ANDRIS Consulting · Pharma Executive Search

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
AlphaPrompt ist ein Münchner B2B-Software-Startup für die institutionelle Immobilienwirtschaft. Unsere Plattform hat zwei Säulen: einen intelligenten Datenraum, der das Dokumentenmanagement vollständig automatsiert, und einen Agentic Workspace, in dem KI-Agenten Prüfungen und Workflows übernehmen – von Mietverträgen über Nebenkostenabrechnungen bis zur Übergabe in Drittsysteme. Unsere Kunden sind derzeit über 50 (institutionelle) Asset- und Property-Manager in der DACH-Region, wir expandieren gerade aber in weitere Märkte.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Du entwickelst die Plattform als solche weiter, damit AlphaPrompt im Kundenalltag reibungslos läuft: Vom Import bis zum Export, in enger Abstimmung mit unserem AI-Team mit dem Ziel: sauber integriert, getestet, für den Kunden nutzbar. Du arbeitest im Plattform-Team mit unserem Lead-Entwickler und eng mit den Gründern zusammen – und bekommst keine fertig zerlegten Kleinst-Tickets, sondern Themen mit Kontext und den Freiraum, sie selbst zu Ende zu denken.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Features über den ganzen Stack bauen – Backend in Python, Frontend in React – von der Idee bis zum Deployment.
  • KI-Funktionen und Agenten unseres AI-Teams in die Plattform integrieren – und verstehen, was dahinter passiert.
  • Das Onboarding neuer Kunden und Objekte vereinfachen: Konfiguration, die heute außerhalb passiert, in die Plattform bringen; Integrationen stabil weiterentwickeln.
  • Ergebnisse selbst prüfen und Kundenfeedback direkt in Verbesserungen übersetzen. Perspektivisch, wenn du willst: Ergebnisse direkt mit dem Kunden abstimmen.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • Zwei bis vier Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise an einem SaaS-Produkt.
  • Full-Stack mit Schwerpunkt Backend (Python) – und du greifst auch ins Frontend (React/TypeScript), statt einen Bogen darum zu machen.
  • Produktverständnis: Du willst wissen, wofür ein Feature da ist, nimmst dir Themen eigenständig und denkst mit, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten.
  • Grundverständnis für LLM- und Agenten-basierte Anwendungen
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch für die Arbeit mit deutschen Dokumenten, im Team und perspektivisch mit Kunden; gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit im Team.
  • Du bist in München (oder ziehst her), willst im Office arbeiten und hast den Drive, dich hinzusetzen und zu bauen – schnell, pragmatisch, sauber.

Nice-to-have: Erfahrung mit ereignisgetriebenen Architekturen und Cloud-Betrieb, mit Dokumentenverarbeitung, OCR oder LLM-APIs – und Lust auf Kundenkontakt.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Ein Produkt, das bei institutionellen Kunden im Einsatz ist – du siehst direkt, was dein Code beim Kunden bewirkt.
  • Kurze Wege: direkt mit den Gründern und dem Lead-Entwickler, Entscheidungen fallen im Raum, nicht im Ticket.
  • KI als Kern des Produkts, nicht als Buzzword – mit der Möglichkeit, dich Richtung KI-Entwicklung oder Kundenprojekte weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag, Büro in München und eine faire Vergütung.

title: Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer - Quantum Computing (m/w/d)
description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

We are looking for a Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and own the real-time firmware that turns our control electronics into a working quantum computer. You will work on our next-generation system, where the control electronics are being integrated into a single, highly integrated chip. You sit at the heart of the machine, between the hardware that generates the pulses and the higher-level software that describes the experiments. Timing is not a detail here; it is the product. You are the person who makes sure the right signal reaches the ions at the right nanosecond, reliably, run after run. 

Responsibilities:

  • Own the embedded firmware on our ARM-based control platform, from architecture through implementation to on-hardware debugging

  • Develop and maintain the real-time software layer that coordinates pulse sequencing, timing, and data flow across our highly integrated control chip

  • Write and maintain the low-level drivers and board support the hardware relies on

  • Guarantee deterministic, low-latency behaviour under hard real-time constraints

  • Lead firmware bring-up together with our electronics and physics teams, and debug at the boundary where software meets signal

  • Define the firmware architecture and engineering practices — build, test, and release processes for the embedded layer as the system matures

  • Contribute to the interfaces between the embedded layer and the rest of the stack, so experiments defined in software run correctly on the machine



Required Skills:

  • 5+ years of professional embedded software development for real-time or timing-critical systems

  • Deep command of C (and ideally C++) on ARM platforms, working close to the hardware

  • Experience with bare-metal and/or RTOS environments, and a clear understanding of when each is appropriate

  • Comfortable reading schematics and datasheets, and debugging real hardware with oscilloscopes, logic analysers, and JTAG

  • Strong grasp of real-time concepts: interrupts, DMA, timing, concurrency, and determinism

  • A track record of bringing up firmware on new hardware, not only maintaining existing systems

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental physicists and engineers, and to turn imprecise physical requirements into robust firmware

  • Strong adaptability and a quick learning mindset

  • Good proficiency in English (written and spoken)

Nice to have (Bonus)

  • Experience on highly integrated SoCs, particularly ARM+FPGA platforms such as Xilinx Zynq / RFSoC

  • Working alongside FPGA/digital-electronics engineers at the software–gateware boundary

  • Rust for embedded systems

  • Embedded Linux on ARM (Cortex-A), including driver and kernel-module work

  • Signal processing or control-loop implementation on embedded targets

  • Experience with high-speed data acquisition or precision timing systems

  • Familiarity with laboratory, scientific, or measurement instrumentation

  • Prior experience with quantum computing or other deep-tech domains


What you can expect from eleQtron:

  • Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding achievements

  • Flexible working hours: We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules

  • Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the culture

  • Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members needs-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development

  • Wellness Package: We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being

  • Bike Leasing: Stay Mobile and Sustainable with Our Company Bike Leasing Program

  • Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus

  • At the forefront: Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications 

  • Modern workplace: We have a high-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices and meeting rooms

title: Cloud Engineer - Quantum Computing (m/w/d)
description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

We are looking for a Cloud Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and build and operate the scalable, secure cloud platform that connects users with our trapped-ion quantum computers.

Responsibilities:

You will join our Quantum firmware Team as a Cloud Engineer. You will build the layer through which the world reaches our quantum computers. Users submit quantum programs; your services compile, schedule, and dispatch them to our machines and return the results:  

  • Build and operate the cloud services that let users submit quantum programs to our systems and retrieve their results.

  • Develop and deploy our compilation pipeline as a scalable cloud service , from circuit input through transpilation down to hardware-level instructions

  • Design and maintain the public API and SDK entry points to our platform 

  • Implement job queuing, scheduling, and dispatch towards the hardware backends, including quota, prioritisation, and result handling 

  • Own authentication and authorisation across the platform: user and tenant identity, API keys and tokens, and role-based access to machines, jobs, and results, built on an established identity provider rather than from scratch

  • Guarantee tenant isolation, so that quantum programs and results are never visible across customer boundaries, and manage secrets and credentials across the stack

  • Work with the quantum firmware and hardware teams on the interfaces between cloud services and the machine itself

  • Instrument the platform for observability and keep an eye on latency, throughput, and cost



Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying backend or platform services in production

  • Strong Python; additional systems-level language experience (Go, Rust, C++) is welcome

  • Solid API design skills (REST and/or gRPC) for services other developers have to use

  • Practical experience implementing authentication and authorisation in production systems: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, token handling, and role-based access control

  • Secure engineering habits: least privilege by default, proper secrets management, and awareness of dependency and container supply-chain risks

title: Paid Social Manager
description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 80 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

UA Manager

Salary range: €65,000-80,000/annum

We're looking for a Paid Social Manager to take ownership of our core app user acquisition channels. This is a high-stakes, hands-on role built for someone who lives in the data, moves fast on optimizations, and knows how to scale app campaigns across AppLovin, Facebook, and TikTok.

You'll be managing significant budgets across live campaigns — this is not a planning role. It requires daily attention, sharp instincts, and the ability to diagnose and fix performance problems in real time.

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Own App UA at Scale: Take ownership of app install campaigns across AppLovin, Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, and DSPs - managing $500k+ in daily spend and optimizing toward revenue and predictive LTV targets.

  • Drive Daily Performance: Monitor live campaigns daily, make proactive budget and bid adjustments, and troubleshoot performance drops without waiting to be asked.

  • Lead Creative Strategy: Analyze top-performing creatives and competitive trends, identify what's working on TikTok and Facebook, and plan a balanced production mix of iterations and new concepts.

  • Manage a Creative Ecosystem: Coordinate with our internal creative team - briefing, reviewing, and prioritizing production to keep testing pipelines moving.

  • Navigate Attribution Complexity: Work across multiple campaign types, manage cross-channel attribution windows and settings, and use Adjust MMP to ensure clean app tracking and accurate performance reads.

  • Build Toward LTV: Set and optimize against primary KPIs rooted in revenue and predictive lifetime value - understanding not just surface metrics but the downstream signals that predict real business impact.

What You'll Bring 💡

  • App UA Track Record: Proven experience scaling app install campaigns across at least two of: AppLovin, Unity, Snapchat, Facebook, TikTok, or programmatic DSPs - with meaningful budget responsibility.

  • Spend-Scale Comfort: You've managed large daily budgets in a live environment and know how to operate with both precision and speed when campaigns are actively running.

  • Creative Judgment: You can analyze performance data to identify what creative is working, brief agencies effectively, and plan a testing roadmap that balances iteration with new concepts.

  • Attribution Fluency: Solid understanding of mobile attribution, MMP setup (Adjust preferred), and how different campaign types and attribution windows interact — especially across app and web.

  • LTV & Revenue Focus: Experience optimizing toward revenue-based KPIs and predictive LTV, ideally in gaming or subscription apps. If you don't have gaming background, you need to clearly demonstrate you understand the metrics that drive performance downstream.

  • Problem-Solving Operator: You diagnose, you act, you iterate. You don't wait for weekly reviews to catch a problem — you're in the account daily and you fix things before they become fires.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  • You treat a live campaign like it's always your responsibility - proactive, not reactive.

  • You think in signals and ratios, not just top-line spend.

  • You're a confident stakeholder manager who can align internal teams and external agencies toward a shared creative and performance roadmap.

  • You're comfortable with complexity - multiple campaign types, channels, and attribution layers - and you build clarity from it rather than getting slowed down by it.

Why Almedia? 🎁

  • Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Senior People Operations Manager (m/f/d)
description:
🎤 Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

 

💡 Your Mission: Build the People Ops function voize will run on

As Senior People Operations Manager, you’ll own People Operations at voize - and build the function from the ground up.

This is our first dedicated People Ops role, so there’s no legacy setup to inherit and no standard playbook to follow. Instead, you’ll have the space to design how People Ops should work at a modern, fast-growing company: automated where it can be, self-service where it should be, and scalable enough to still work when we’ve doubled in size.

We build AI that gives nurses more time for what matters. Your job is to bring that same mindset to our People function - cutting admin, removing friction, and creating an employee experience that sets the standard for how modern companies should operate.

 

🚀 What You'll Own - the mandate in detail

  • Own the employee lifecycle end to end: Onboarding to offboarding with the mandate to redesign how it works, not just run it.

  • Be the trusted point of contact: Own the people topics that need judgment and discretion - and build the self-service, automation and agents that make routine questions disappear.

  • Build a first-class People Ops foundation: Modern, AI-native processes, clear ownership and documentation, and a seamless employee experience from day one.

  • Automate what shouldn’t be manual: Build a reliable source of truth and the workflows and AI agents around it - so documents, deadlines, data checks and repetitive admin run without human intervention.

  • Make us global-ready: Entity vs. EOR decisions, global payroll architecture and local employment compliance across every market we operate in - with audit-proof documentation the whole way.

 

🤝 Your Skillset – What you bring to the table

  • You've scaled People Ops before: Several years of ownership in a fast-growing tech company, and you know from experience which processes break at which headcount.

  • German payroll and employment law are your home turf: Payroll preparation, contracts, statutory deadlines and audit topics - you work at this level of detail without needing a lawyer for every question.

  • You've worked beyond Germany: Multi-country People Ops: entities, EOR, global payroll, local employment law. You've done at least one market entry and know where it gets expensive. US experience is a strong plus.

  • You're AI-first, like us: We work AI-first and expect the same from you: you build your own automations and agents. When you see a repetitive process, your instinct is to remove it, not to staff it.

  • You're a builder, not a caretaker: You've insourced, migrated or rebuilt a function before, you write documentation people actually use, and you'd rather own an ambiguous mandate than a tidy job description.

  • You are fluent German (C1+) and English.

🌱 Growing together – what you can expect at voize

  • We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving healthcare professionals more time for real patient care

  • We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely from Germany

  • Become a co-creator of our success with stock options

  • Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible

  • You decide when you work best, that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up

 

✨ Ready to talk? Apply now! 🚀

The people who thrive in this role want real ownership. You’d rather write the playbook than follow one, and you’re equally comfortable designing the operating model and getting into the details that make it work. You move fast, adapt quickly and see changing priorities as a chance to build the next, better version.

About the team:

The On Holiday Support team helps customers resolve issues that arise while they are away. This can include transfer problems, accommodation concerns, supplier issues, flight disruption and other unexpected situations that may affect a customer’s holiday.

Customers may contact us when they are tired, worried, frustrated or unsure what to do next. Our role is to listen, understand what has happened and take ownership of finding the most appropriate resolution.

You will be part of the UK On Holiday Support team and report to an On Holiday Support Team Leader. You will also work closely with colleagues in our offshore partner team and with suppliers and internal departments across loveholidays..

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. As this role requires some attendance at our London office, applications from candidates with a commute of more than 2 hours each way will not be considered.

The impact you’ll have:

You’ll support customers at moments when the service we provide can have a real impact on their holiday, taking ownership and responding with empathy, urgency and sound judgement.

This means investigating what’s happened, communicating clearly and working towards practical resolutions. Some cases will be straightforward, while others may require supplier contact, further investigation or escalation to specialist teams.

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. A customer-first mindset and strong problem-solving skills are essential, particularly when handling more challenging cases and helping restore customers’ confidence in loveholidays. You’ll also support English-speaking customers across our international markets.

High performers may have opportunities to develop into specialist areas, including wellbeing and safeguarding.

Your day-to-day:

  • Support customers through telephone, chat and case-based contact while they are on holiday

  • Listen carefully, understand the customer’s circumstances and identify the most appropriate next steps

  • Take ownership of customer issues and work towards a resolution wherever possible

  • Use good judgement to balance customer needs, urgency, safety, policy and commercial considerations

  • Contact hotels, transfer providers, airlines and other suppliers to investigate issues and agree solutions

  • Make outbound calls when speaking directly with a customer or supplier is the quickest and most effective way to resolve an issue

  • Keep customers updated and set clear expectations throughout their case

  • Recognise risk and escalate safeguarding, wellbeing or major incident concerns through the correct process

  • Maintain clear, accurate and complete case notes

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues in the UK, our offshore partner and other loveholidays teams

  • Identify recurring customer or supplier issues and provide feedback so that the underlying cause can be addressed

  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of relevant processes, policies, systems and travel-industry developments

  • Strong and demonstrable customer-service skills

  • A calm, empathetic and professional communication style

  • Confidence speaking with customers who may be upset, frustrated or under pressure

  • Strong ownership and a willingness to see issues through to resolution

  • Sound judgement and the confidence to make decisions within agreed guidelines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong problem-solving and investigative skills

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail

  • Emotional resilience and the ability to work effectively with sensitive or challenging customer situations

  • A collaborative approach and confidence working with colleagues from different teams and cultures

Du baust Systeme, die in Produktion gehen. Bei uns übernimmst du die technische Verantwortung, von der Architektur über die Umsetzung bis in den produktiven Betrieb, und bringst LLM-Anwendungen dahin, wo sie im Alltag der Kund:innen echten Wert schaffen.

Your mission is to build the financial foundation that enables Geordie to scale with confidence. You'll combine rigorous financial management, thoughtful planning and modern systems to give the business the insight, discipline and operational excellence it needs to grow.

Initially, you will be a hands-on individual contributor responsible for building and operating the finance function. You'll own financial planning, reporting, forecasting, cash management and financial operations, while working closely with our external finance partners who manage bookkeeping, VAT and other compliance processes.

This is not a traditional finance role focused solely on reporting historical numbers. We are looking for someone who enjoys building systems, improving processes and helping leadership make better decisions through high-quality financial analysis and insight.

Over time, you'll build an exceptionally efficient finance function that leverages automation and AI wherever practical, allowing the team to scale alongside the business without growing linearly with headcount.

What You'll Do

Financial Leadership

  • Own the finance function end-to-end, initially as Geordie's sole internal finance hire.

  • Build robust financial planning, budgeting and forecasting processes that support rapid company growth.

  • Own the company operating model, including revenue, ARR, hiring plans, cash runway and scenario modelling.

  • Produce clear, high-quality reporting for leadership, the Board and investors.

  • Partner closely with the CEO and leadership team to provide financial analysis that supports strategic decision-making.

Financial Operations

  • Own cash flow management, treasury oversight and working capital.

  • Oversee invoicing, accounts payable and financial operations, working closely with external finance partners.

  • Build scalable quote-to-cash processes alongside RevOps and Legal, ensuring strong financial controls as the business grows.

  • Ensure banking, insurance and core financial infrastructure operate effectively.

  • Own financial compliance across our UK and US entities, including tax requirements, R&D claims and coordination with external advisers.

Business Performance

  • Develop a deep understanding of the company's unit economics, gross margins and customer profitability.

  • Help leadership understand where capital is being deployed most effectively and provide financial insight to support investment decisions.

  • Support commercial teams with financial analysis around customer profitability, pricing, commercial structures and larger customer opportunities.

  • Partner with Product as a finance domain expert, providing input into the evolution of Geordie's cost management capabilities.

Finance Systems & Automation

  • Help build a modern, highly efficient finance function through thoughtful use of AI, automation and best-in-class financial systems.

  • Work closely with our Internal Systems & AI Lead to identify opportunities to automate finance workflows, improve reporting and reduce manual effort.

  • Continuously improve finance systems, processes and controls to increase the leverage of the finance function as the company scales.

Fundraising & Growth

  • Support future fundraising processes through financial modelling, investor reporting and due diligence.

  • Help ensure the business maintains the financial discipline and operational maturity required to scale.

  • Over time, build and lead a lean, high-performing finance team as the complexity of the business grows.

Ideal Background

  • Experience leading finance within a high-growth B2B SaaS or technology company.

  • Strong background in FP&A, strategic finance or commercial finance, with the ability to build robust financial models and planning processes.

  • Comfortable operating as a hands-on individual contributor while building functions from first principles.

  • Experience producing Board and investor reporting and supporting fundraising or due diligence processes.

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate financial data into actionable business insight.

  • Experience improving finance systems, processes and operational workflows.

  • Curious about AI and excited by the opportunity to build a modern, highly automated finance function.

  • Highly proactive, organised and comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving environment.

Why This Role

Finance has an opportunity to change dramatically over the coming decade. We believe AI and automation will fundamentally change how finance teams operate, allowing small teams to deliver far greater leverage than ever before.

At Geordie, we want to build a finance function that embraces that opportunity from day one. Rather than scaling through headcount alone, we want to scale through better systems, better automation and better decision-making.

This role offers the opportunity to build that function from the ground up and, over time, grow it into a world-class finance organisation while helping shape the future of one of the fastest-growing AI security companies.

Our Values

Solve What Matters

We listen intently and stay focused on what truly matters to our customers. If it doesn't help them navigate real-world agentic adoption and risk, it's probably not worth building.

Build, Learn, Iterate

We favour momentum over perfection; testing, learning, and evolving through action. It's how we move fast and get better, together.

Kind, Not Comfortable

We're honest, respectful, and unafraid to challenge each other. We believe doing great work should feel good, too. Kindness makes that possible.

We're rebuilding that moment. ClaimSorted is an AI-native claims solution for insurers and large corporates that resolves claims faster, fairer, and more reliably than the industry ever has. title: Financial Control Accountant
description:
About Us

ClearBank is a technology-enabled bank transforming banking infrastructure through innovative technology and a full banking licence. We provide cloud-based banking and payment solutions to a growing range of clients and are committed to delivering reliable, scalable financial services while maintaining the highest standards of financial control, governance and regulatory compliance.

The Financial Control team is responsible for ensuring ClearBank’s general ledgers are controlled, maintained and reconciled to support timely and accurate reporting across the organisation and externally to regulators and tax authorities. As ClearBank continues to grow, the team plays a critical role in building scalable, efficient and well-controlled finance processes that support the Bank’s strategic ambitions.

Role Purpose

The Financial Control Accountant (mid level) is a key member of a small, hands-on Financial Control team, responsible for contributing directly to the month-end close process and supporting the delivery of accurate, timely and well-controlled financial information. The role will own individual tasks and areas of responsibility.

Reporting to the Financial Control Manager, Financial Control Accountant (mid Level) will be actively involved in preparing and supporting core financial control activities, completing month-end tasks, investigating balances and variances, and working through accounting entries and reconciliations to ensure the general ledger is accurate and fully supported.

The role will also be expected to stay close to all key aspects of the Financial Control team’s remit, including journals, reconciliations, reporting inputs, controls, audit support, process documentation and stakeholder queries. As ClearBank continues to grow, the role will be at the forefront of identifying, driving and implementing scalable, efficient and well-controlled processes, helping the team reduce manual effort while maintaining strong financial control standards.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Control & Reporting

  • Own allocated month-end close activities and ensure they are delivered accurately and on time

  • Prepare, review and approve general ledger journals as required, ensuring postings are technically accurate, appropriately supported and comply with internal control requirements

  • Own revenue and expense analysis for the relevant areas, ensuring variances are investigated, understood and appropriately communicated to stakeholders

  • Partner with Financial Planning & Analysis to ensure accruals and accounting adjustments are identified, calculated and recorded accurately

  • Prepare, review and approve bank reconciliations as required, ensuring reconciling items are investigated and resolved promptly

  • Own monthly balance sheet reconciliations for the relevant areas, including preparing and reviewing reconciliations where required, ensuring all balances are fully supported and outstanding issues are appropriately managed

  • Own the monthly capitalisation and amortisation process for intangible assets, ensuring entries are accurate, supported and appropriately controlled

  • Take ownership of non-automated accounting entries, ensuring they are accurate, appropriately supported, controlled and clearly documented, with clear audit trails maintained

  • Build and implement scalable, efficient processes while remaining hands-on in day-to-day delivery where needed

  • Support the preparation of management, regulatory, statutory and tax reporting requirements as required

  • Ensure compliance with accounting policies, financial reporting standards and internal control frameworks

Systems, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Help drive and implement automation and process improvements across finance processes, controls and reporting activities, helping to reduce manual effort and improve scalability

  • Lead initiatives to automate the capture and posting of accounting entries from ClearBank’s core banking and operational systems into the general ledger

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability and data quality across Financial Control processes

  • Drive the adoption of AI-enabled tools and technologies to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy and enhance team productivity

  • Ensure process changes are documented appropriately and supported by effective control frameworks

Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong working relationships across Finance and the wider business to support accurate financial reporting and operational effectiveness

  • Work collaboratively with Accounts Payable, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Regulatory Reporting and external auditors to ensure reporting requirements are met

  • Support audit activities by coordinating information requests and providing timely, accurate responses

  • Contribute to cross-functional projects requiring accounting, control or process expertise

Skills & Experience (must-have)

  • Fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA)

  • Strong financial accounting and financial control experience within a regulated financial services, banking or fintech environment

  • Experience managing month-end close activities, balance sheet reconciliations and general ledger controls

  • Strong technical accounting knowledge, including experience interpreting and applying accounting standards

  • Experience supporting complex accounting areas, including preparing analysis and documentation to support technical accounting judgements

  • Strong understanding of financial controls, governance and audit requirements

  • Proven ability to identify, lead and implement process improvement initiatives

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong financial analysis capability

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment

  • High attention to detail combined with a pragmatic and solutions-focused mindset

Nice-to-have

  • Experience within a regulated bank or payments organisation

  • Experience with share-based payment accounting

  • Experience supporting statutory accounts, regulatory reporting or tax reporting processes

  • Experience implementing finance systems, automation solutions or reporting enhancements

  • Knowledge of data analytics, AI-enabled tools and workflow automation technologies

description:
Financial Reporting Manager

About ClearBank

ClearBank is a technology enabled clearing bank, built on a modern cloud-based platform. We provide real-time clearing and embedded banking services, enabling our clients to build better financial services. Our culture is grounded in trust, ownership, and collaboration, empowering our people to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and each other.

Role Purpose

The Financial Reporting Manager is responsible for leading the Group’s external financial reporting, including end-to-end ownership of the Annual Report and Accounts (ARA), consolidated financial statements and statutory accounts. The role ensures accurate, timely and compliant reporting in line with IFRS, regulatory requirements and corporate disclosure standards, while coordinating stakeholders across Finance, the wider business and external audit.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Reporting & Statutory Accounts

  • Own and lead the end-to-end preparation of the Group’s Annual Report and Accounts, including the consolidated IFRS financial statements, notes and disclosures, and project manage compilation of the front-half strategic and governance reports

  • Prepare and oversee standalone statutory accounts for regulated banking entities in the UK and EU, including the primary statements, supporting notes and front-half narrative sections

  • Translate IFRS, company law, regulatory and corporate reporting requirements into complete, accurate and appropriately evidenced financial statement disclosures

  • Develop and maintain robust working papers, disclosure checklists, review processes and scalable financial controls that support the accuracy, completeness and auditability of published reporting

  • Own the detailed reporting plan and critical path, coordinate inputs and reviews across multiple stakeholders, manage dependencies and risks, and deliver against Board, audit, filing and other external deadlines

Audit & Assurance

  • Lead the external audit workstream as part of the wider statutory reporting cycle, acting as the primary point of contact for auditors and internal stakeholders

  • Coordinate audit evidence and responses across the business, ensuring requests are resolved efficiently without compromising ownership or delivery of the financial statements

  • Monitor audit progress, judgement and outstanding matters, escalating and resolving issues to protect the reporting timetable and governance process

  • Drive the timely resolution of audit findings and ensure agreed actions are embedded into future reporting processes and controls

  • Prepare robust going concern assessment papers using the 5-year planning projections, latest ICAAP and other applicable internal reports and liaising with relevant internal stakeholders.

Maintain strong, current knowledge of IFRS and apply it in drafting, reviewing and supporting the Group’s financial statements, accounting policies, notes and disclosures

  • Assess the impact of new and revised IFRS standards, amendments and IFRIC interpretations, as well as emerging corporate reporting requirements and FRC updates, through structured horizon scanning and impact assessments

  • Partner with Financial Control and other subject-matter experts to implement new or amended accounting requirements, including IFRS 18, and reflect business developments appropriately in external reporting

Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across Finance and the wider business

  • Early engagement of stakeholders to ensure alignment on reporting requirements and timeliness of delivery

  • Influence and coordinate multiple contributors to deliver high-quality, FTSE-grade outputs

  • Be the owner, act as a trusted advisor and the go-to on external reporting matters

Governance & Board Reporting

  • Prepare impactful Board-level papers including going concern assessments, horizon scanning, and annual report and audit updates

  • Support the Board Audit Committees’ reporting throughout the reporting cycle including the co-ordination of annual report reviews

  • Ensure clear, concise, and high-quality communication of financial information to senior stakeholders

Essential

  • At least two years’ recent, hands-on experience preparing and project managing and owning the Annual Reports and Accounts and statutory financial statements, ideally within fintech, banking, payments or broader financial services

  • Strong practical knowledge of IFRS, with the ability to apply accounting and disclosure requirements when drafting and reviewing financial statements, notes and accounting policies

  • Demonstrable experience preparing consolidated financial statements and statutory accounts from planning and working papers through review, approval and filing, rather than experience limited to external audit

  • Strong stakeholder management, technical writing and attention to detail, with the ability to explain accounting judgements and influence across Finance and the wider business

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with relevant post-qualification financial reporting experience

Desirable / Nice to have:

  • Experience preparing Annual Reports and Accounts for regulated banking or financial services entities in the UK and/or EU

  • Experience applying complex IFRS requirements, developing accounting policies and preparing technical accounting papers and disclosure assessments

  • Familiarity with Board and Audit Committee reporting, governance reviews and the statutory approval and filing process

title: AI Engineering Intern
description:
At Light, we’re redefining how software is built, how it’s delivered, and how it works.

We’re building organic software. Software that heals itself. Software that adapts to the user and the business. Software that learns and gets better as it’s used.

Our starting point is finance. Companies including Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy already run on Light. We’re building towards a platform that understands how each business operates and evolves with it.

As an AI Engineering Intern, you’ll help make that happen: building systems that identify mistakes, improve their own behaviour, and prove those improvements work. You’ll work on the agents, models, and infrastructure that turn organic software into something customers can rely on.

Who this is for

You must meet both of these requirements:

  • Currently studying at University of Oxford, or University of Cambridge.

  • A silver medal or higher at the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) or International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI), or an equivalent level of achievement in another highly competitive endeavour.

If you’re applying with an equivalent achievement, explain the competition or field, your result, and the standard required to achieve it. If you’re at Oxford/Cambridge and you don’t have an equivalent level of achievement we encourage you to not apply.

Our bar for internships at Light is high. You will need the curiosity to explore unfamiliar areas, the willingness to go the extra mile to get things right, the discipline to test your assumptions, and the persistence to keep going when your first approach does not work.

What you’ll work on

You’ll have access to our repositories, real engineering problems, and an internal coding agent that already opens pull requests against production code. Your work will help make these systems more capable and reliable.

  • Help agents learn from their work. Our agent reviews merged pull requests and corrections to update its repository-specific instructions. You’ll shape that process, catch misleading lessons, and test whether new instructions improve its performance.

  • Train and deploy LLM and ML models. Fine-tune SoA LLM models. Run experiments, compare results against the existing pipeline, and establish whether a model is ready for production. Leverage ML tools to enhance the ability of our Agents via e.g. K-means, t-sne, PCA, random forest trees etc. etc.

  • Build Agents. Take full end to end ownership of an agent. Agent do pre-emptive support for the self-healing pipeline; they fix; they communicate with customers; etc.

  • Build evaluations and review tools. Define what a correct answer looks like, create tests that expose failures, and help catch poor output before it reaches customers.

  • Own projects through delivery. Scope the problem, build the solution, debug regressions, and follow through until the customer can rely on what you’ve shipped.

You’ll work alongside exceptional colleagues.

What else we’re looking for

  • Strong programming ability.

  • Something you’ve built beyond coursework or tutorials: a model, agent, tool, or application that does useful work.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tooling, such as LLM APIs, agent frameworks, model fine-tuning, or automated workflows.

  • A habit of investigating why a system failed and testing whether your fix addresses the cause.

  • Clear thinking and the ability to explain your decisions, including what you tried and why it didn’t work.

Open-source contributions, deployed models, and experience building evaluation pipelines are a plus.

How we’ll measure success

Your work should produce measurable improvements: more correct agent-generated changes, better model accuracy, fewer failures reaching users, or tools the team continues to use. You’ll help define those measures and use them to assess what you build.

What you’ll get

  • Internship compensation above the standard market rate.

  • A role based in our London office, working alongside the product and engineering team.

  • Ownership from your first day, with a path to shipping work into production.

How to apply

More in Common is a research agency working across the US, UK, Germany, France, Spain and Poland to tackle polarisation and division. More in Common leads and supports initiatives to build more united, inclusive, and resilient societies. Our mission is to understand the forces driving us apart, help societies find common ground and bring people together to tackle shared challenges. 
 
In the UK, our work is best described as being part consultancy and part think tank. We provide a full suite of research services including polling and focus group research; evidence reviews and secondary data analysis; audience mapping and audience strategy; strategic communications strategy and campaign development. More in Common are members of the British Polling Council. 
 
Our work is informed by our ground-breaking segmentation of the British public. This unique values-based lens to our quantitative and qualitative research means we can understand not only what the public thinks of the big challenges facing British society today – but crucially why they think it. Our insights help leaders in government, the media, business, and civil society to develop better strategies and communications – particularly in reaching disengaged communities far from the Westminster/London bubble – and to better navigate tricky and divisive issues. 
 
Over the last year, More in Common has published agenda-setting thought leadership on a whole range of debates facing British society – including exploring the public’s starting points on assisted dying and immigration; understanding how the British public is navigating major debates from trans and gender identity to the conflict in Israel and Palestine; and our political research has helped policymakers and politicians understand the dramatic fragmentation of our politics. Our work is regularly covered in the British press and media and we’ve developed a series of partnerships with broadcasters and newspapers to deliver top-quality research insights. In the 2024 General Election, we were among Britain’s most accurate pollsters and used our focus group research to put people and public opinion at the centre of coverage of the election campaign.
 
Through our consultancy, More in Common has also supported dozens of partners with insights and strategic communications support. We’ve helped national institutions such as the BBC, British Library and National Trust to better understand their audiences, we’ve helped partners in government and civil society with the set-up and delivery of the Homes for Ukraine scheme, and we’ve supported a range of partners to test their policy proposals from the National Farmers Union to Rethink Mental Illness among many others.
 
More in Common has a range of exciting projects in the pipeline, including: 

  • Understanding the key dynamics of public attitudes to climate change and the energy transition.
  • Exploring public opinion on immigration, integration and multiculturalism.
  • Embedding our new Seven Segments with a wider range of organisations, including developing new products and trainings to help people understand the segments.
  • Helping navigate declining trust in institutions, for example exploring why trust in universities and science appears to be falling.

More in Common is seeking a Senior Research Associate to deliver high-quality research projects. The role will be based in our London office Monday-Thursday with Friday at the office or working at home.

We understand that not everyone with the skillset for this role will have all of the above – that is fine. We are most interested in your intellect, aptitude and experience to date, and your willingness to throw yourself into tackling some of the biggest issues in understanding the forces driving British society apart.


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We will have a better chance of uniting divided societies if our team reflects a broad range of social and cultural backgrounds, beliefs, political opinions, and life experiences. We particularly encourage applications from underrepresented and minority communities

🤖 Who we are

Alan Clinic. A health companion and a digital clinic for everyone.

We're a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. The Clinic is two crews building one experience:

We're building a medical experience that works reliably, safely, and at scale. An AI agent, and the clinic behind it. You'll lead the engineering team and you'll keep building alongside them.

The crews work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. As their engineering leader, you own:
